title: Redline's corrected reply still rewords a sentence the check passed, and says the headline credits several of Elm Quay's supervisors
body:
*This was generated by AI while building #477.*

Measured while building #477 and filed from its exit, which files every miss of the candidate reading that ships.

## What was measured

A statement of Redline's reply that was true in the draft the reply checker read, and that the run made false when it corrected the reply after the check — with the #477 candidate in place, which tells the run to deliver every sentence no checker item names in the draft's words.

- **Run:** `post-case-study-clean-file-2` in `docs/evaluation/editorial-477/runs/` (on the branch `kntnt-orchestrate/main/477` until it is integrated), `case-study-clean` delivered to `output.md`, `claude-opus-5-5` at high deliberation.
- **The draft the checker read** (`states/draft-reply.md`): *Olöst: ”arbetsledare” har samma form i singular och plural, så den som bara ser rubriken kan läsa den som att Elm Quays arbetsledare i plural anser det …*
- **The delivered reply** (`states/final-reply.md`): *Den som bara ser rubriken kan därför läsa det som att flera av Elm Quays arbetsledare anser det …*
- **The delivered headline:** *Elm Quays arbetsledare anser att gemensam ärendebild hjälper.* Its plural reading credits Elm Quay's supervisors as a group, not *several of* them.
- **The checker's return** (`states/check-return.md`) named two other statements; no item named this one.
- **Judges:** correction judge A records it under *Made false*; correction judge B reads *flera av* as still supported. The #477 plan puts a miss in a run on one judge.

## Why it is filed

The candidate ships because it halves the runs carrying such a miss (7 of 12 before, 2 of 12 after). It did not stop the rewording: in nine of the candidate's twelve runs the correction judges still count between 7 and 21 statements reworded after the check, against 7 to 34 in all twelve runs before it. This is one of the two remaining misses; `results.md` in the same directory records both.

comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** bug
**Summary:** Make Redline apply the reply check as bounded edits and preserve every unmentioned statement verbatim.

## What to build

Diagnose why Redline still retells its checked reply when applying individual checker findings. Deliver every sentence no checker item names in the draft's words, and for a named sentence change only the fault the item identifies, keeping its other attribution, scope and certainty. Do not add unchecked statements about either text. Correct the application boundary rather than adding a second statement of the freeze rule #477 already shipped. Preserve the one-shot check and the frozen final Text Artifact.

**Verification and redundancy check:** Compared #477's `post-case-study-clean-file-2` draft, checker return and final reply. The checker names two other faults; the passage explaining the headline's plural reading is retold as `flera av Elm Quays arbetsledare`. The current reply-check reference already prohibits that unrequested retelling. This is a measured residual of its shipped candidate, not a request for a rule that is absent. The correction judges disagree over whether `flera av` is false; #477's one-judge-miss rule filed it. Record that disagreement and distinguish it from the directly visible, unrequested wording change. No fresh native run was launched during triage. No `.out-of-scope/` KB exists; the prior rejection of a widened attribution checker in the #478 decision concerns a different stage and does not dispose of this residual.

**Key interfaces:** The reply-check brief's two-list return, the caller's application of that return, the checked reply draft and final reply. The final Text Artifact is never changed here. #490 owns false statements already present in the draft and passed by the checker; #491 owns unnecessary edits to the article itself.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Commit a frozen plan before native runs, based on #477's two-arm, twelve-run matrix and neutral-path reply/transition judging. Use a fresh pre-change arm on the current shipped wording and one provider-native seat. Preserve each complete received text, checked-delivered text, draft reply, checker return and terminal reply. Validate the state extractor before freezing it; disclose missing states rather than treating them as an empty checker return.
- [ ] Count unauthorized post-check rewriting independently from factual errors: a sentence no checker item names that reaches the reader in different words is a freeze miss even if still true; a named sentence changes only what the item calls for. Record wording-only, made-false-after-check and already-false-before-check cases separately.
- [ ] Freeze the judging rule in advance. Retain #477's one-judge-miss rule for factual misses and preserve both readings of a split, including the historical `flera av` split. Judge what the texts support, not whether the report uses a favored replacement phrase.
- [ ] When the fresh baseline reproduces an application miss, try the smallest diagnosed correction. The target is no unrequested rewriting or added text statements in candidate replies, with every checker item addressed and no new false statement introduced. Cases with an empty checker return deliver the draft's text statements verbatim; necessary formatting/assembly is not permission to paraphrase them.
- [ ] Attribution contrasts from #477 still distinguish an asserted cause, withheld attribution and explicit denial; the final artifact is byte-identical to the artifact the checker was given, and the final mechanical pass, source preservation, delivery and cleanup contracts remain satisfied.
- [ ] If the fresh baseline shows no application miss, record non-reproduction and ship no speculative wording. Otherwise use only the protocol's bounded revise/ship rule, report residual misses honestly and file them. Neither this ticket nor its judges repair article-level defects owned by #491 or count #490's checker false negatives as post-check corruption.
- [ ] Regenerate the catalog after shipped-file changes and pass the four project checks in CONTRIBUTING.md.

**Out of scope:** Changing Swedish singular/plural usage, weakening the freeze to allow harmless retelling, adding a second reply check, correcting the Text Artifact after Proofread, and widening attribution accounting as declined in #478.
